summary: Interprets receipt 7ee579ae94bd4812beaa21ce1ca9bb2e, which fills the startup account's last stated gap: real-prefix restarts whose snapshot shortened the replay instead of eliminating it. A prefix committing 200 commands, snapshotting, then committing 200 more restarts with a 198-entry tail, four batches, and NewRaft returned in 3 ms; the same prefix shape with 8300 more commands leaves an 8299-entry tail, 130 batches, and NewRaft did not return within five seconds, leaving one goroutine in processLogs. All three comparisons decided as the mechanism predicts (control returns, replay is a non-zero four batches, the long case fails to return). The account keeps its violated conclusion and asserted defect, replaces the limitation that called this region inferred with the measurement at four and 130 batches, notes that no real prefix was restarted with a tail between five and 129 batches, and keeps the seeded nine-batch case as the middle bracket. Knowledge entries 1255b78953904846987cdc19826340c8-knowledge-0 and -1 gain the new receipt's executions, and joint_history records that it comes from a separate experiment identifier building the prefix the same way as earlier real-prefix cases, differing only in taking the snapshot between two batches and recording the snapshot index and replay arithmetic. The submission validates with zero schema errors and requests no execution.
